name: Closing Loop
when_to_pick: The article's final block. Always loops back to the opening pain point and hands the reader one concrete next move, with the shape matched to the article's intent class. Pick variant='informational' when the reader's journey continues across pages (a loop line, a short synthesis paragraph, and 2-3 deeper-reading links). Pick variant='commercial' when the conclusion IS a recommendation (a loop line, one 'decide' card carrying logo+name+reason+CTA, plus an honest alt-path escape hatch for readers who can't take the pick). Pick variant='transactional' when the explicit goal is conversion (a centered loop line, a bold value reaffirmation, one big CTA, and a row of trust marks that mirror the transactional hero at the top of the article). Use exactly once, as the last visual in the piece.

variant.description: Which close shape to render. informational=synthesis + deeper-reading links (accent); commercial=decide card + alt path (warning); transactional=big CTA + trust marks (success).

loop_lead.description: Optional plain-text lead-in for the loop line, e.g. 'We started with' or 'You came in'. Defaults per variant when omitted.

loop_from.description: The opening pain point, restated. Rendered in the italic 'opening' chip. Plain text.

loop_mid.description: Optional connective text between the opening and closing chips, e.g. 'and arrived at' or 'here's the one that does'. Defaults per variant when omitted.

loop_to.description: The closing answer this article delivered. Rendered in the bold colored 'closing' chip. Plain text.

title.description: Trusted inline HTML (rendered |safe). The close headline. For transactional, wrap the key phrase in ... to color it success. English only.

body.description: informational only. Trusted inline HTML (rendered |safe). One short synthesis paragraph connecting the dots and pointing at the next layer.

links.description: informational only. Deeper-reading links shown under the 'Continue your research' label.

meta.description: Optional sub-line, e.g. 'The follow-up to this article . 8 min read'. Plain text.

links_label.description: informational only. Uppercase eyebrow above the links list.

decide.description: commercial only. The single recommended pick card.

logo.description: Optional 1-3 char monogram for the logo tile (e.g. 'SB'). Omit to hide the tile. Plain text.

reason.description: Trusted inline HTML (rendered |safe). Why this is the pick — concrete, evidence-based, no guaranteed-profit language.

label.description: Button text, e.g. 'Start free'. Plain text.

alt.description: commercial only. Trusted inline HTML (rendered |safe). The 'Not your fit?' escape hatch — name the edge case and link the alternative path. Include any <a> inline.

sub.description: transactional only. Sub-headline under the title, e.g. trial terms. Plain text.

cta.description: transactional only. The single primary call to action.

sub_cta.description: transactional only. Trusted inline HTML (rendered |safe). Secondary line under the big CTA, e.g. 'Or book a demo'.

trust.description: transactional only. Trust marks shown in a row beneath the CTA.

icon.description: Optional leading glyph/emoji, e.g. '⚡'. Plain text.

metric.description: Bold value, e.g. '9ms' or '4.8/5'. Plain text.

label.description: Trailing descriptor, e.g. 'verified latency'. Plain text.
